rationale:
The reviewed tests adequately check `requirements.sdk.graph.agent-harness.OllamaConfig`.

**Struct shape and builders**
- `backend_builders_set_only_the_requested_fields` checks that `OllamaConfig::new` serializes to only `{"model": ...}`. It then applies `endpoint`, `api_key_env`, `api_key` and `option` and asserts the full JSON. That JSON has all five fields, the model preserved, and a repeated option key overwritten (`a` becomes 2, `b` stays true).
- The same test shows the builders set only the requested fields.
- `src/agent/config.rs` marks the struct `#[non_exhaustive]`. The configured.rs test builds the struct literal from inside the crate, so that attribute is not exercised from outside.
- `public_exports_match_the_appendix` in `tests/public_api.rs` checks the public export inventory against the book.

**Trait implementations**
- `all_backends_preserve_nested_settings_and_credentials` deserializes an Ollama `AgentConfig` JSON value. It checks that serializing it again gives the same value, and that a JSON string round trip gives an equal config. That covers `Serialize`, `Deserialize` and `PartialEq`.
- `Clone` and `Debug` are plain derives on `OllamaConfig`. They have no conditionals or transformation of their own, so they fall under the testing exemption for untested obligations.
- `OllamaConfig` has no custom `Debug`. The redaction in `SecretString` is not part of this requirement's text.

**Endpoint, credentials, options configure requests**
- `option_defaults_and_credential_resolution_are_deterministic` checks the default endpoint, `http://localhost:11434`. It checks that no key resolves to `None`. A missing `api_key_env` variable gives an error that names the variable. An explicit `api_key` resolves to its value. The same test checks that an `OptionValue::Float(NAN)` in an Ollama option map makes `options_json` return an error.
- `supplied_ollama_backend_delivers_tools_and_results_over_native_chat` runs against a real local TCP server. It uses a custom `endpoint`, an `api_key` and an option `num_predict` of 256. The server asserts the request goes to `POST /api/chat` with `Authorization: Bearer local-ollama-key`. It also asserts that the request body has `model` equal to `local-ollama` and `options.num_predict` equal to 256.

Each obligation in the text has a test that exercises it and asserts the outcome. I found no gap.

text: `model` names the model on the Ollama server. The endpoint, credentials, and inference options configure requests to that server.
pub fn endpoint(self, endpoint: String) -> Self;
pub fn api_key_env(self, api_key_env: String) -> Self;
pub fn api_key(self, api_key: SecretString) -> Self;
pub fn option(self, key: String, value: OptionValue) -> Self;
